coverage.description: Installed Python HTTPStatus snapshot plus three selected browser-security headers; not a full/live IANA registry or security-policy evaluator.
coverage.unknown_means: Not present in this offline glossary; consult the relevant specification rather than assuming maliciousness.

sources.license: Python Software Foundation license; local PYTHON-LICENSE.txt
sources.scope: Installed HTTPStatus names, phrases, and descriptions; not a live IANA registry mirror.
Status semantics and heuristic cache eligibility; SOC notes are concise analyst context.

cache_rules.heuristic_eligible: Heuristic freshness may be used when method and other caching rules permit; explicit cache controls take precedence.
cache_rules.explicit_policy_required: This code alone does not permit heuristic freshness; inspect explicit caching directives, method, authorization, and other constraints.
cache_rules.interim: Interim response, not a standalone reusable representation.
cache_rules.validation: Validates an existing cached representation; updates its metadata rather than supplying a new response body.

statuses.name: CONTINUE
statuses.description: Request received, please continue

statuses.name: SWITCHING_PROTOCOLS
statuses.description: Switching to new protocol; obey Upgrade header

statuses.name: PROCESSING
statuses.description: Server is processing the request

statuses.name: EARLY_HINTS
statuses.description: Headers sent to prepare for the response

statuses.name: OK
statuses.description: Request fulfilled, document follows
statuses.soc_note: Success alone does not establish a safe response.

statuses.name: CREATED
statuses.description: Document created, URL follows

statuses.name: ACCEPTED
statuses.description: Request accepted, processing continues off-line

statuses.name: NON_AUTHORITATIVE_INFORMATION
statuses.description: Request fulfilled from cache

statuses.name: NO_CONTENT
statuses.description: Request fulfilled, nothing follows
statuses.soc_note: Successful response without a message body.

statuses.name: RESET_CONTENT
statuses.description: Clear input form for further input

statuses.name: PARTIAL_CONTENT
statuses.description: Partial content follows
statuses.soc_note: Partial response; range validation matters for cache recombination.

statuses.name: MULTI_STATUS
statuses.description: Response contains multiple statuses in the body

statuses.name: ALREADY_REPORTED
statuses.description: Operation has already been reported

statuses.name: IM_USED
statuses.description: Request completed using instance manipulations

statuses.name: MULTIPLE_CHOICES
statuses.description: Object has several resources -- see URI list

statuses.name: MOVED_PERMANENTLY
statuses.description: Object moved permanently -- see URI list
statuses.soc_note: Permanent redirects may persist in caches.

statuses.name: FOUND
statuses.description: Object moved temporarily -- see URI list
statuses.soc_note: Temporary redirect; inspect Location without following it.

statuses.name: SEE_OTHER
statuses.description: Object moved -- see Method and URL list

statuses.name: NOT_MODIFIED
statuses.description: Document has not changed since given time
statuses.soc_note: Cache validation, not a new response body.

statuses.name: USE_PROXY
statuses.description: You must use proxy specified in Location to access this resource

statuses.name: TEMPORARY_REDIRECT
statuses.description: Object moved temporarily -- see URI list
statuses.soc_note: Temporary redirect preserves the request method.

statuses.name: PERMANENT_REDIRECT
statuses.description: Object moved permanently -- see URI list
statuses.soc_note: Permanent redirect preserves the request method.

statuses.name: BAD_REQUEST
statuses.description: Bad request syntax or unsupported method
statuses.soc_note: Malformed request; correlate surrounding traffic before attributing intent.

statuses.name: UNAUTHORIZED
statuses.description: No permission -- see authorization schemes
statuses.soc_note: Authentication challenge; distinguish from an authorization refusal.

statuses.name: PAYMENT_REQUIRED
statuses.description: No payment -- see charging schemes

statuses.name: FORBIDDEN
statuses.description: Request forbidden -- authorization will not help
statuses.soc_note: Refusal does not necessarily mean missing credentials.

statuses.name: NOT_FOUND
statuses.description: Nothing matches the given URI
statuses.soc_note: Absence can be deliberate; consider expected application routes.

statuses.name: METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED
statuses.description: Specified method is invalid for this resource
statuses.soc_note: Check Allow for supported methods.

statuses.name: NOT_ACCEPTABLE
statuses.description: URI not available in preferred format

statuses.name: PROXY_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
statuses.description: You must authenticate with this proxy before proceeding
statuses.soc_note: Proxy authentication differs from origin-server authentication.

statuses.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT
statuses.description: Request timed out; try again later

statuses.name: CONFLICT
statuses.description: Request conflict

statuses.name: GONE
statuses.description: URI no longer exists and has been permanently removed

statuses.name: LENGTH_REQUIRED
statuses.description: Client must specify Content-Length

statuses.name: PRECONDITION_FAILED
statuses.description: Precondition in headers is false

statuses.name: CONTENT_TOO_LARGE
statuses.description: Content is too large
statuses.soc_note: Request content exceeds an accepted size.

statuses.name: URI_TOO_LONG
statuses.description: URI is too long

statuses.name: UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE
statuses.description: Entity body in unsupported format

statuses.name: RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE
statuses.description: Cannot satisfy request range

statuses.name: EXPECTATION_FAILED
statuses.description: Expect condition could not be satisfied

statuses.name: IM_A_TEAPOT
statuses.description: Server refuses to brew coffee because it is a teapot
statuses.soc_note: Legacy teapot label; RFC 9110 reserves 418 as unused.

statuses.name: MISDIRECTED_REQUEST
statuses.description: Server is not able to produce a response

statuses.name: UNPROCESSABLE_CONTENT
statuses.description: Server is not able to process the contained instructions

statuses.name: LOCKED
statuses.description: Resource of a method is locked

statuses.name: FAILED_DEPENDENCY
statuses.description: Dependent action of the request failed

statuses.name: TOO_EARLY
statuses.description: Server refuses to process a request that might be replayed

statuses.name: UPGRADE_REQUIRED
statuses.description: Server refuses to perform the request using the current protocol

statuses.name: PRECONDITION_REQUIRED
statuses.description: The origin server requires the request to be conditional

statuses.name: TOO_MANY_REQUESTS
statuses.description: The user has sent too many requests in a given amount of time ("rate limiting")
statuses.soc_note: Rate limiting may include Retry-After; investigate request patterns.

statuses.name: REQUEST_HEADER_FIELDS_TOO_LARGE
statuses.description: The server is unwilling to process the request because its header fields are too large

statuses.name: UNAVAILABLE_FOR_LEGAL_REASONS
statuses.description: The server is denying access to the resource as a consequence of a legal demand

statuses.name: INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
statuses.description: Server got itself in trouble
statuses.soc_note: Unexpected server condition; correlate server diagnostics.

statuses.name: NOT_IMPLEMENTED
statuses.description: Server does not support this operation

statuses.name: BAD_GATEWAY
statuses.description: Invalid responses from another server/proxy
statuses.soc_note: Invalid upstream response; distinguish gateway from application failures.

statuses.name: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
statuses.description: The server cannot process the request due to a high load
statuses.soc_note: Temporary unavailability may include Retry-After.

statuses.name: GATEWAY_TIMEOUT
statuses.description: The gateway server did not receive a timely response
statuses.soc_note: Upstream timeout; inspect dependency behavior.

statuses.name: HTTP_VERSION_NOT_SUPPORTED
statuses.description: Cannot fulfill request

statuses.name: VARIANT_ALSO_NEGOTIATES
statuses.description: Server has an internal configuration error

statuses.name: INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE
statuses.description: Server is not able to store the representation

statuses.name: LOOP_DETECTED
statuses.description: Server encountered an infinite loop while processing a request

statuses.name: NOT_EXTENDED
statuses.description: Request does not meet the resource access policy

statuses.name: NETWORK_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
statuses.description: The client needs to authenticate to gain network access

headers.name: Strict-Transport-Security
headers.purpose: Remember an HTTPS-only host policy in supporting browsers.
notes: Browsers accept this policy over HTTPS, not HTTP. It does not validate the current response.
max-age=0 removes the host policy after secure receipt; subdomain policies can remain independent.
includeSubDomains expands scope. The preload token alone does not establish preload-list membership.
Header presence does not prove secure TLS configuration.

headers.name: Content-Security-Policy
headers.purpose: Constrain resource loading and other document capabilities through explicit directives.
notes: Evaluate individual directives and effective fallbacks; a policy name alone says little about protection.
Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only reports violations without enforcing its restrictions.
frame-ancestors controls embedding and is not a default-src fallback.
Inline-script exceptions and broad sources need application-specific review; no vulnerability verdict is automatic.

headers.name: X-Frame-Options
headers.purpose: Control document embedding in supporting browsers.
notes: DENY blocks framing; SAMEORIGIN restricts it to same-origin ancestors.
ALLOW-FROM is obsolete and is ignored by modern browsers; do not treat it as effective protection.
Use CSP frame-ancestors for richer embedding policy. A meta element does not enforce this header.
Embedding controls are not general authentication or cross-origin data controls.

limitations: Status, cache eligibility, and header presence are observations, not security verdicts.
Cache behavior depends on method, request/response directives, authorization, and context; no-store and other restrictions still apply.
Legacy or extension names in the installed Python enum may differ from the current registry. No requests are sent and references are not refreshed automatically.
redistribution: Status names/descriptions originate from PSF-licensed Python data; retain PYTHON-LICENSE.txt. Other explanatory notes are short original summaries with cited MDN/RFC references, not copied documentation bodies.
